## Description
**What did you change?**


## Type of change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality, e.g., new enemy, weapon, or UI element)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 🎨 Assets update (added new sprites, background art, animations, or audio)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring (cleaning up `core/`, `managers/`, or `entities/` logic)

## Module/Area Affected
- [ ] `assets/` (Visuals/Audio)
- [ ] `js/core/` (Game Engine, Inputs, Saves)
- [ ] `js/managers/` (Levels, Waves, Shop, UI)
- [ ] `js/entities/` (Player, Enemies, Projectiles)
- [ ] `js/utils/` (Physics, Constants)
- [ ] HTML/CSS (`index.html` / styling)

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Tested on easy/medium/hard difficulty settings.
- [ ] Checked browser console for any JavaScript errors.
- [ ] Verified that `SaveManager.js` properly stores/loads state if applicable.
- [ ] Tested Canvas rendering (no flickering, proper sprite loading).

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the existing style and structure of the project.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas (like `Physics.js` collision math).
- [ ] I have tested that my changes do not break the main Game Loop.
- [ ] Any new sprites or audio files are properly placed in their respective `assets/` subfolders.
